Published Benchmark

Build the market view

Start with the market story first. The benchmark view groups nearby source sizes into simpler client-facing bands so multiple salary guides can be read side by side.

Quick-start roles

Why This View Works

Every salary range is monthly pay as published by the source guide, so the market picture stays grounded in real benchmark rows.

The benchmark average is the midpoint between each source's minimum and maximum, which keeps the summary simple without hiding the spread.

The source table stays in sync and keeps the original guide band visible on every row, so the headline range always has evidence behind it.

Current Focus

Pick a role and size band to surface the strongest comparison view and show the exact source cards.
